reason: Under 'Modify items', policy states: 'This action can only be called once, and will change the order status to pending (items modifed). The agent will not be able to modify or cancel the order anymore.' Furthermore, under 'Modify pending order', 'An order can only be modified if its status is pending, and you should check its status before taking the action.' After calling modify_pending_order_items, the order status became 'pending (item modified)', making any further modification (address change) prohibited.
